taskDescription: Goal: single living HR task tracker for MKCD (HKM Hyderabad) covering every instruction given to HR Manager Rajendra Prasad (RP) and HR Executive Gnaneshwar (GN). Intent: MKCD follows up pending items weekly; GN works them in ClickUp (RP does not use ClickUp); recurring items become permanent R&R. Sources: WhatsApp exports (HR group Aug 2025-Oct 2026, RP 1:1, GN 1:1) + sweep of Claude Docs Action Items list, HR Dept R&R doc, employee living docs, ClickUp other spaces, Notion People & Operations plan, Drive MASTER action register.
